For workers & families

Help that comes to you — in your language

Whether you work in construction, a factory, a home, a farm or on the road — a trained Saathi near you can help with schemes, jobs, money transfer and documents.

See services WhatsApp us
50+services
500+schemes accessible
₹200average saving per transaction
~2 hrssaved per transaction
01
OverviewWho we serve and what changes with a Saathi
Who we serve

Built for India’s informal workforce

Migrant workers

Construction, factory and service workers far from home.

Daily wage earners

Workers who can’t lose a day’s pay standing in queues.

Families & women

Households needing schemes, insurance and documents.

Rural communities

Farmers, senior citizens and first-time bank users.

The difference

Life before and with a Saathi

Without Online Saathi

A full day’s leave to send money home
Middlemen charging fees for jobs and forms
Missed entitlements — no one explains eligibility
Apps and offices in an unfamiliar language
No one to call when something goes wrong
VS

With Online Saathi

~2 hours saved and ₹200 saved per transaction, on average
Verified jobs and clearly displayed service fees
Schemes checked and applied for with your Saathi
Help in your own language, from someone local
Human support by phone, WhatsApp and in person
Use cases

How workers use Online Saathi

Construction worker in a new city

Migrant worker, far from home
Need

No registration as a worker, so no access to welfare-board benefits or insurance.

Saathi helps

Registers on e-Shram, enrols with the construction welfare board and accident insurance.

Outcome

Covered for accidents, eligible for education and health benefits for the family.

Sending money home to Nepal

Nepali worker in India
Need

Taking a day off and paying extra every month to send money to family.

Saathi helps

Sends money through a partner remittance service, to any bank in Nepal, with a receipt.

Outcome

Fast, low-cost transfers without losing a day’s wages.

Domestic worker securing her family

Woman worker, no bank paperwork
Need

No PAN, no insurance and unsure which schemes apply to her.

Saathi helps

Applies for PAN, checks scheme eligibility and enrols her in life and accident insurance.

Outcome

Documents in place and her family protected, in her own language.

Young worker looking for a safe job

First job outside the village
Need

Asked by agents to pay for a job, with no way to verify the employer.

Saathi helps

Matches him to verified openings through Safe Jobs Connect, free of middlemen.

Outcome

A verified job, and someone to call if anything goes wrong.

Illustrative use cases based on the services we deliver every day.

02
ServicesAll six services in detail
Safe Jobs Connect Welfare Schemes Micro ATM PAN Card Center Travel & Bills Neo Banking & Remittance

Safe Jobs Connect

Verified local job opportunities matched to your skills and location — with a Saathi to support you from profile to hiring.

Job seekersRural workersMigrant workersEmployersTraining centres

FEATURES

Local job discovery Resume & profile builder Skill-based matching Saathi-assisted applications Trusted employer network Application tracking Skill assessment Career guidance

HOW YOU GET IT

Meet a Saathi or open the app
Build your profile and resume
Get matched to verified openings
Apply with Saathi support and track status

BENEFITS

  • No middlemen fees
  • Support at every stage until hired

Social Welfare Schemes

Find the government schemes you qualify for — pensions, insurance, scholarships and livelihood schemes — and get help until benefits are approved.

Daily wage workersFarmersWomenSenior citizensStudents

FEATURES

Eligibility finder Document checklist Application support Status tracking Renewal reminders Scheme alerts Regional languages Helpline support

HOW YOU GET IT

Check eligibility with a Saathi or the scheme finder
Gather documents using the checklist
Apply with Saathi assistance
Track status and get renewal reminders

GOOD TO KNOW

We guide you on eligibility, documents and process. Approval is decided by the scheme authority — never pay anyone who promises approval.

Micro ATM Services

Essential banking at your doorstep — withdraw cash, check balance and get mini statements with your Aadhaar and fingerprint.

Rural usersSenior citizensFarmersDaily wage workersSmall business owners

FEATURES

AEPS transactions Fingerprint security Fast withdrawals Balance checks Mini statements Cash deposit support Local centres Trained Saathi agents

HOW YOU GET IT

Visit a Saathi point near you
Share your Aadhaar number and bank
Verify with your fingerprint
Collect cash and your receipt

BENEFITS

  • No long trip to a bank branch
  • Secure Aadhaar-based verification

PAN Card Center

New PAN applications, corrections, updates and verification — handled start to finish by a Saathi. No technical knowledge needed.

First-time applicantsJob seekersSmall business ownersStudentsRural residents

FEATURES

Guided applications KYC support Verification help Status tracking Document assistance Form guidance Affordable service Secure handling

HOW YOU GET IT

Visit a Saathi with your ID documents
Saathi fills and checks your form
Complete KYC and submit
Track status until your PAN arrives

BENEFITS

  • Opens doors to bank accounts, tax filing and formal work

Travel & Bill Payments

Book bus and train tickets and pay electricity, mobile and DTH bills — in one place, without queues, with clear receipts.

Migrant workersHouseholdsDaily commutersSmall businessesSenior citizens

FEATURES

Bus & train tickets Travel support Electricity bills Mobile recharge DTH payments Payment reminders Multiple operators Secure transactions

HOW YOU GET IT

Tell your Saathi where you’re going or which bill to pay
Confirm details and amount
Pay and receive your ticket or receipt

GOOD TO KNOW

Bookings are made through authorised partners; refunds and rescheduling follow the operator’s policy.

Neo Banking & Remittance

Digital accounts, wallets and fast, secure money transfer — within India and from India to Nepal — with a Saathi guiding you in your language.

Migrant workersFamiliesDaily wage earnersNew bank users

FEATURES

Digital accounts Instant remittance Secure transfers Wallet services Transaction history Financial guidance Doorstep service Any bank in Nepal

HOW YOU GET IT

Visit a Saathi with your ID
Complete KYC once
Enter beneficiary details carefully
Send money and keep your receipt

BENEFITS

  • Families receive money quickly and safely
  • Build a banking history for future credit
03
How to get helpThree easy ways to reach us

Visit a Saathi

The easiest way, especially for first-timers.

  1. Call or WhatsApp us to find the nearest Saathi
  2. Carry your ID and mobile phone
  3. Explain what you need — in your language
  4. Get it done and take your receipt

Use the app

For workers comfortable with a smartphone.

  1. Download Online Saathi from Google Play
  2. Register with your mobile number
  3. Choose a service and follow the steps
  4. Tap “Talk to a Saathi” if you get stuck

Call or WhatsApp

Ask a question or get connected.

  1. Call +91 90990 05251
  2. Or message us on WhatsApp
  3. Tell us your district and need
  4. We connect you to the right Saathi
WhatsApp us Get the app Call the helpline
Step by step

What happens when you ask for help

Reach out

Call, WhatsApp, app or visit

Talk

Saathi listens in your language

Check

Eligibility & documents

Apply / pay

Through authorised partners

Follow up

Status updates & support

What to carry

Keep these handy

Your Saathi will tell you exactly what each service needs. Commonly asked for:

ID proof

Aadhaar, PAN, passport, citizenship or driving licence.

Mobile phone

For OTPs and SMS confirmations — never share the OTP with anyone else.

Bank details

Account details for transfers, schemes and AEPS.

Scheme papers

Work, address or income proof where a scheme needs it.

FAQ

Common questions

How do I find a Saathi near me?

Call or WhatsApp +91 90990 05251, or open the Online Saathi app. We’ll connect you to the nearest trained Saathi.

Do I need a smartphone?

No. Your Saathi can do everything on your behalf, with your consent and in your language.

What does it cost?

Many services are free; some carry a small, clearly displayed service fee. Always ask for a receipt. We do not collect government application fees.

What if a payment fails?

If money is deducted but the transaction fails, it is refunded to the original method within 3–21 working days. See our Refund Policy.

Which languages do Saathis speak?

Saathis are local, so they speak your regional language — including Hindi and Nepali.

average saving per transaction

~2 hrs

~₹10,000

scheme benefits received by some workers

Your benefits

What you get with Online Saathi

Government schemes

Find what you are entitled to and get help applying.

  • e-Shram registration
  • Insurance & pension enrolment
  • Welfare board registration
  • Ration portability

Safe jobs

Find work without paying middlemen.

  • Verified job openings
  • Referrals to employers
  • Skill-building guidance
  • Support if something goes wrong

Send money home

Fast, secure and low-cost remittance.

  • India to Nepal, to any bank
  • Domestic money transfer
  • Receipt for every transfer
  • No full-day leave needed

Cash & banking

Banking at your Saathi point.

  • Aadhaar cash withdrawal (AEPS)
  • Balance enquiry & mini-statement
  • Account opening support

Documents

Done correctly, the first time.

  • New PAN & corrections
  • ID and certificate support
  • Help with forms

Travel & bills

Everyday payments in one place.

  • Bus tickets home
  • Mobile & DTH recharge
  • Electricity & utility bills
Scheme finder

Which schemes could help you?

Answer three quick questions. Your Saathi will confirm eligibility and help you apply.

Indicative only. Final eligibility depends on official scheme rules.

Pick your answers to see suggested schemes.
Stay safe

Your safety comes first

  • Online Saathi will never ask for your OTP, PIN or password.
  • Always ask for the Saathi’s ID before sharing documents.
  • Get a receipt for every transaction.
  • Never pay anyone to get a job — report it to us.
Report a problem
How do I find a Saathi near me?

Call or WhatsApp +91 90990 05251, or open the Online Saathi app. We’ll connect you to the nearest trained Saathi.

Do I need a smartphone?

No. Your Saathi can do everything on your behalf, with your consent and in your language.

What does it cost?

Many services are free; some carry a small, clearly displayed service fee. Always ask for a receipt.

Can I send money to Nepal?

Yes. Our partner remittance services let you send money to any bank in Nepal quickly and securely.

Which languages do Saathis speak?

Saathis are local, so they speak your regional language — including Hindi and Nepali.
